identity_block: The hand is Grace's real hand from the reference photo: warm brown skin, square medium-length nails painted pink with crisp white French tips, her own small gold ring with a clear heart-shaped stone on one finger and her silver crown-style engagement ring on the ring finger. One hand enters from the frame edge with the whole wrist visible, natural relaxed fingers, five fingers, realistic knuckles and skin texture.
box_block: The box is the real Mute Starter Pack from the box reference photo: tall charcoal-black box, white lowercase 'mu:te' wordmark with a purple colon, white 'BREATHE MORE / SNORE LESS / SLEEP BETTER', a purple corner flag 'TRY ME FIRST', a round window showing a clear dilator, a purple band 'STARTER PACK / SMALL · MEDIUM · LARGE', 'RHINOMED LIMITED' at the bottom. Keep every word, colour and proportion exactly as in the reference.
dilator_block: The dilator is the real Mute nasal dilator from the tray reference: clear soft plastic, two small ribbed cylindrical stents joined by a thin U-shaped clear bridge loop, about 3 cm wide. The purple tray card holds three of them stacked in a black tray. Keep its exact shape; it is clear, never coloured.
scene_night: Cosy bedroom at night, warm bedside lamp light, pink and white striped cotton sheets, real phone camera look, sharp focus, shallow depth of field, no text except the real box printing, no watermark.
scene_day: Same bedroom in soft morning daylight, pink and white striped cotton sheets, real phone camera look, sharp focus, shallow depth of field, no text except the real box printing, no watermark.
video_suffix: Handheld phone camera, smooth natural motion, real speed, the hand, box and dilator keep their exact shape, colour and printing in every frame, no flicker, no morphing, no extra fingers, no new text.

shots.still: Close-up of the bed edge: her hand grips the corner of a white pillow on the striped sheets, a person-shaped lump under the duvet in the soft background, face never visible.
shots.video: She yanks the pillow off the bed and drags it out of frame toward the dark hallway; the handheld camera whips after it and settles on a sofa with a folded blanket.
shots.vo: This is for the people who always end up on the couch because somebody will not stop snoring.

shots.still: Bedside table top in lamp light: a pair of orange foam earplugs and a small roll of plain white tape with no brand, her fingers reaching in from the side, an open wooden drawer below.
shots.video: Her fingers sweep the earplugs and the tape roll off the table into the open drawer and push it shut with a quick bump; the camera pushes in on the table.
shots.vo: You've tried nudging them, earplugs, even mouth tape that leaves a circle on your face.

shots.still: Her hand holds the Mute box upright above the striped sheets, front facing the camera, lamp glow behind.
shots.video: Her hand lifts the box up into frame and turns it a quarter turn to face the camera; the camera orbits slowly around it.
shots.vo: This is Mute. It's a tiny clear dilator that sits just inside the nose and gently opens it.

shots.still: Top-down on the striped sheets: her fingers pull the purple tray card halfway out of the open Mute box, the three clear dilators visible in the black tray.
shots.video: Her fingers slide the purple tray card fully out of the box; the camera pushes down toward the three clear dilators.
shots.vo: In their trial, seventy-five percent of users said they snored less.

shots.still: Macro: her thumb and index fingertip hold one clear Mute dilator by its U-shaped bridge, just lifted out of the purple tray card below, lamp light catching the clear plastic.
shots.video: She lifts the dilator up out of the tray and gently opens its loop a little wider between two fingertips; the camera arcs slowly around her fingers with a light rack focus.
shots.vo: The starter pack comes with all three sizes, so you find the one that fits, and each one lasts up to ten nights.

shots.still: Bedside table: her hand reaches for the switch of the warm bedside lamp, the empty purple tray card lying next to it.
shots.video: She clicks the lamp off and the room drops into soft blue night; the camera drifts slowly toward the quiet bed.
shots.vo: Honestly, the worst part is losing your excuse to kick them at two a.m.

shots.still: Morning light on the bedside table: two Mute boxes standing side by side, her hand resting on top of one.
shots.video: She slides one of the two boxes forward toward the camera like a gift, then taps its top; the camera pushes in on the box front.
shots.vo: Holiday trips mean shared rooms, so grab one for you and one for your dad. It's in the orange cart.

shots.still: Side profile macro of the lower nose only, mouth and eyes out of frame: her fingertips place the clear dilator just inside the nostril, only the clear bridge loop showing.
shots.video: Her fingertips ease the dilator into place and the hand slides away out of frame; the camera holds steady on the side profile, mouth never in frame.
